description: Use this when the user asks where Horseback is or how to get there (gdzie to jest, jak dojechać, dojazd do Huciska): returns the address, GPS coordinates, Google Maps links (place and route), opening hours of classes and transport for groups (minibuses and coaches from anywhere in Poland, priced individually). It has no data on public transport or parking - for these, give the user the contact details it returns. Use it also when a group (school, company) asks only how to get there or about a coach - do not call get_group_trip_offer for such questions.

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.

name: get_directions

contact.description: Horseback contact: phone, email, website, social profiles.

location.description: Name and address of the centre.
